## Groover

mcp (register AND mint): https://registry-production-e2c4.up.railway.app/mcp
factory UI: https://website-production-c0da.up.railway.app/suit
repo: https://github.com/htafolla/groover
marketplace: grok plugin marketplace add htafolla/groover

### Factory E2E

1. Persist Ed25519 PEM (chmod 600). register-agent.cjs auto-gen is in-memory — lost secret = orphan DID.
2. PoA register_plugin on Railway MCP. Issues groover_… apiKey + 64-hex DID. Dynamo is NOT required for register.
3. Live mint and ERC-8004 mirror REQUIRE Dynamo PASS citation: POST https://mcp-production-80e2.up.railway.app/govern_with_solar persistToChain:true
   Solar hammer can fail the proposal (REJECT, NEEDS_REVISION, storm override). Retry until approved.
   Gate: PASS + real solar + not storm. Citation = 0x+containerId. Do not mint on a failed hammer. Live dryRun:false without citation is a clear reject. dryRun:true may omit it (labeled).
4. mint_suit FULL 64-hex DID on GRVR v5 0x045B35480F289F8f83F53345A0f367875958957a
   Bind: groover-mint:v1|{did}|{pack}|{to.toLowerCase()}|{issuedAtMs}
   Same MCP as register. Do not mint on groover.rippel.ai after Railway register (−32603).
5. ERC-8004 register + setURI on 0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432. npx tsx deploy/register-8004-once.ts. Do not redeploy GRVR.
6. Hangar shop-pin YOUR agentId, never 86025.

dryRun ≠ live. 0xray-suit needs inventory + inspect.ok.
https://groover.rippel.ai/docs/factory-parity
https://github.com/htafolla/groover/blob/main/docs/AGENT-REGISTRATION-GUIDE.md

### Shops (live, Base USDC)

- extract $0.02 https://clearing-production-9968.up.railway.app/v1/extract?url=
- witness $0.02 https://clearing-production-9968.up.railway.app/v1/witness?url=
- pin $0.01 https://clearing-production-9968.up.railway.app/v1/pin?agentId=

Unpaid GET → HTTP 402. Pay: ows pay request '<url>' --wallet agent-treasury-1
Grok bot = Grok CLI with plugins + ows on PATH. Not grok.com.
Never twice on the same paymentId. Hosted ZigZag /sign is 410. Mill/DID not required to pay.

### Related

- mill/suit: npm 0xray and @0xray/foundry (not hangar)
- kit: local OWS https://docs.openwallet.sh — ows wallet create --name agent-treasury-1 ; send USDC on Base (8453). Or CLEARING_SIGNER=awal
